parameters.content:
## Phase 0 safety controls

- Static mock Full Steam Vapor facts only.
- Duplicate review IDs stop before token generation.
- Sensitive parent executions are not retained.
- Raw tokens appear only in the email and transient workflow memory; only the HMAC digest is stored with the review.
- Every durable event is allowlisted through the sanitized audit workflow.
- Gmail is send-only.
- No Google Business, Facebook, Gemini, OpenAI, or publishing node exists.
